title: Shrimp deveiner and peeler
text: Shrimp deveiner and peeler. These work.. however, the wooden handles on the deveiner is really awful and cheap.  DON'T wash in dishwasher - ruins the super cheap wooden handles. The peeler appears to stainless and is fine in the dishwasher.  You get 4 pieces in total, 2 of each tool.  I would look to purchase something with silicone handles and not wood of any kind. product_metadata.title: 2 Sets Shrimp Deveiner Tool Stainless Steel Shrimp Peeler Portable Shrimp Cleaner Knife Prawn Shell Peeler for Kitchen Shrimp Peeling Tools
features: Amount of package: you will receive 2 pieces of shrimp deveiner tools and 2 pieces shrimp peelers in this package, good kitchen tools can help you effortlessly peel off shells on the shrimps, bring you much convenience in daily life

Sturdy and long lasting: the shrimp cleaner knife set is made of stainless steel material, sturdy and long lasting to use, rust proof and wear resistant, pointed tip provide you precise and quick peeling experience, durable enough to accompany you long term

Appropriate size: the prawn deveiner measures approx. 20.5 x 3.5 x 8.2 cm and the shrimp peeler measures approx. 17 x 2 cm, feature long and smooth handle part for comfortable grasping experience, suitable size for most people to use

Fast shell peeling experience: you should firstly remove the shrimp head and then insert the pointed tip of the shrimp deveiner into the top of shell, gently press handles together until shrimp and shell separate, finally you can use the shrimp peeler to pick up the shrimp line in the middle, wash the finished shrimp under running water and place into your dish, easy and quick to operate, good for handling shrimp at home

Applicable seafood: suitable for home and seafood restaurants to use, can be applied for peeling and deveining various hard shelled seafood, such as shrimps, lobster, prawns, crawfish or crab legs, facilitate your food preparation process
